rationale: PP01 flagged five bdc_investment_identifier values as subtotal candidates, but the raw SOI shows each is an individual investment row with issuer, terms or maturity, and cost/fair value cells. The category text in the normalized identifiers comes from surrounding schedule headings, not from subtotal rows: HPC GPFS Arsenal Co-Invest (Cayman) LP is table 15 row 11; Mews Systems B.V. equity is table 15 row 17; Rapyd Netherlands B.V. first-lien debt is table 13 row 22; Mews Systems B.V. first-lien debt is table 14 row 3; Acronis International first-lien debt is table 14 row 18. The check is overbroad for legitimate hierarchical position labels.
